changelog:
- Initial release of Meeting Agenda Creator.
- Automatically generates professional meeting agendas with smart time allocation and discussion points.
- Includes role assignment (facilitator, note-taker, timekeeper) and action item tracking templates.
- Features pre-built templates for common meeting types and customization options.
- Supports adding pre-reading materials and exporting agendas for distribution.
summary: Automatically generate professional meeting agendas with time allocation and discussion points
